chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Bazie, from Salih ibn Uqba, from Yazeed ibn Abd al-Malik, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Visit each other, for in your visitation there is a revival of your hearts; and mention our Ahadeeth, and our Ahadeeth would incline you towards each other. So if you were to grab hold of it, you would be Guided and attain salvation, and if you were to neglect these, you would stray and be destroyed. Therefore grab hold of these, and I would be (personally) responsible for your salvation.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of visiting one another according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the spiritual and social dimensions of ziyarat, framing it not merely as a ritual but as a vital mechanism for sustaining communal identity and transmitting the Imamate's teachings. By linking physical visitation to the 'revival of hearts' and the preservation of ahadeeth, the Imam underscores the interdependence of individual piety and collective adherence to divine guidance. The promise of salvation serves as a theological assurance, reinforcing the concept of the Imam as the guarantor of the believers' ultimate success in this life and the hereafter.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Ismail Bin Bazie, from Salih Bin Uqba, from Yazeed Bin Abdul Malik,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Visit each other, for in your visitation there is a revival of your hearts; and mention our<sup>asws</sup> Ahadeeth, and (for) our<sup>asws</sup> Ahadeeth would incline you towards each other. So if you were to grab hold of it, you would be Guided and attain salvation, and if you were to neglect these, you would stray and be destroyed. Therefore grab hold of these, and I<sup>asws</sup> would be (personally) responsible for your salvation’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Isma’il ibn Bazi’ from Salih ibn ‘Aqabah from Yazid ibn ‘Abd al-Malik from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:

“Visit each other; in it there is a revival for your hearts and a study of our Ahadith (may take place). Our Ahadith helps you to be kind to each other. If you follow them you will find guidance and salvation in them. If you disregard them you will go astray and be destroyed. Therefore, follow them and I will assure you of your salvation.”
